text:
claire: Quick heads-up  Kelvin Labs agreed to a short case interview + 10m video clip next Wed 9:30am PT. Need legal on quote clearance and logo permissions. Also want webinar leads routed to 'kelvin-webinar' SDR queue.

dan: I'll set up recording and request separate takes for social. Can product paste the exact quote candidates so legal can pre-check?

sophie: Pasting verbatim from the demo notes (will confirm on mic):
"Switching to Redwood Dedicated reduced our 95th percentile latency from ~350ms to about 210ms under load."
"Using Redwood's KV cache and batching cut our GPU costs by ~33% in the pilot."
"Rollout was seamless  we shipped without a rollback and stayed within our SLA target."

jared: I'll include a consent checkbox and asset release link on the invite. If they won't sign for logo use, we can publish quotes + company name only with written ok.

sophie: Legal flag: any percent claims need a metrics snapshot or written confirmation. If they prefer not to share numbers publicly, we'll use conservative phrasing like 'meaningful reduction' and put exact numbers in a gated appendix.

dan: Sample SFDC webhook for lead routing (auth omitted):
POST /hooks/sfdc HTTP/1.1
Host: hooks.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json

{ "source": "kelvin-webinar", "email": "{registrant_email}", "name": "{registrant_name}", "utm_campaign": "kelvin-launch", "target_queue": "Kelvin Webinar" }

claire: Customer requested embargo: publish earliest 2026-05-22 08:00 PT. Sophie, can legal sign off by 5/18 EOD?

sophie: Yes I can review quote text by EOD tomorrow. I'll draft a one-paragraph release and a redaction checklist.

dan: Invite sent and recording enabled. I'll upload raw clips + transcripts after the call.

ops-bot: Calendar invite "Kelvin Labs case interview" created by dan for 2026-05-20 09:30 PT.

claire: Great  I'll add tasks to the launch playbook: legal sign-off (sophie), release & logo permission (jared), landing page + webhook test (demand gen). Ping when each is done. :rocket:
